title: Swin Meets EfficientNet: Lightweight Architectures for GAN-Based Face Forensics
abstract: arXiv:2609.01749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern generative models, such as GANs, diffusion architectures, and autoregressive systems, now produce facial images that are nearly indistinguishable from authentic photographs. This capability makes detecting forged images increasingly difficult, raising serious concerns about identity theft, fraud, and misinformation campaigns. Our research focuses specifically on GAN-generated synthetic faces, which underpin many face-centric deepfakes, and investigates efficient detection approaches using image analysis alone. Existing detection systems rely heavily on either convolutional neural networks (CNNs) or global vision transformers. While CNNs excel at identifying texture-based local features, they struggle with broader contextual understanding. Traditional Vision Transformer (ViT) models can capture long-range structures effectively, but demand substantial computational resources. Our work explores Swin-Transformer-based architectures

translated_title: Swin 遇见 EfficientNet：面向 GAN 人脸取证的轻量级架构
translated_abstract: 现代生成模型，如生成对抗网络（GAN）、扩散架构和自回归系统，如今能够生成与真实照片几乎无法区分的面部图像。这种能力使得伪造图像的检测日益困难，引发了对身份盗窃、欺诈和虚假信息活动的严重担忧。我们的研究专门针对 GAN 生成的合成人脸——这是许多以人脸为中心的深度伪造的基础——并研究仅通过图像分析实现的高效检测方法。现有的检测系统主要依赖卷积神经网络（CNN）或全局视觉变换器。虽然 CNN 擅长识别基于纹理的局部特征，但它们在更广泛的上下文理解方面存在不足；而传统的视觉变换器模型虽然能有效捕捉长程结构，却需要大量计算资源。我们的工作探索了基于 Swin-Transformer 的架构。
tldr: 本文提出将 Swin Transformer 与 EfficientNet 相结合的轻量级混合架构，以在有限计算资源下高效检测 GAN 生成的合成人脸图像，兼顾局部纹理特征与全局上下文理解能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight hybrid architecture combining Swin Transformer and EfficientNet to efficiently detect GAN-generated synthetic faces under limited computational resources, balancing local texture features with global contextual understanding.
